title: So what do we all do?

posts.body:
there are so many different WAHMs i just wondered what you all did! im about to launch pinkfairycake.com, and online kids cookery store. Check out the blog htp://pinkfairycake.blogspot.com
What do you all do???

I'm a full time mum but I own my own window cl 😏 eaning business so all I have to do is the paper work side of things-invoices,taxes,diaries etc and collecting money from a few of the clients. I bought the business for my husband really but I'm still THE BOSS on paper and only I can access the account etc

[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST]
GTTkel said:
I'm a full time mum but I own my own window cl 😏 eaning business so all I have to do is the paper work side of things-invoices,taxes,diaries etc and collecting money from a few of the clients. I bought the business for my husband really but I'm still THE BOSS on paper and only I can access the account etc
[/QUOTE]
I need a window cleaner, mine are filthy!  😊
I run Chelltune.co.uk which is a website for anyone with an interest in Sign Language.
Good luck with your new site PFC.

Well, in my large amount of time I am home ( all the time due to depression ) I moderate this forum, supply the Audio story corner here and will be bringing back Retro Radio in the near future. It keeps me busy, and I also do my bit in looking after the apple of my eye ( what an odd saying ) David...I will be a SAHD, strange that sounds like Sad....yes, I will be a Stay at home Dad when Carly completes her college course and moves into full time employment. I will be focusing on starting a Video game/PC business from home when the time is right, as well as keeping the house in order...quite looking forward to it all to be honest.  🙂

i am a SAHM of isaac - 8 and tallulah 17 mths. have been for the past 3 years and i absolutely love it. i wouldnt miss lulah walking in the room with her dad's shoes on or her learning to jump like a chimpanzee for anyone.
my wonderful husband works 9-5 during the week as an IT manager and he works thurs - sun in basildon's nightclub complex as a medic, not to mention the photography course he has been doing and his nights at st johns (so he can get his quals for medic job)we only get tuesday nights together.
we need to pay off our wedding that we had in feb so i wanted to contribute financially and also do something with my time at home with lulah so i have set up a party plan business and now it has a website
www.semolinapilchard.co.uk
selling funky kids clothes, instruments and toys.

I work part time as a customer service advisor I work 3 days a week and that is enough having a little boy.
Shellx

I am Christina and I run my own Wedding, Portrait and Product photography company  😀
www.christinajaynephotography.com

I stay at home monday to friday and then on weekends my little girl goes to my mums and i go to work in an airport as groundstaff for a major airline normally boarding flights and doing some work on the desk selling tickets and taking excess payments and then when majorly busy walk the queue and make sure everyone is checking in and deal with customer enquiries etc

I am Stephanie and WAHM to Tyler who is 3 at the end on the month!
I own Bay-Bee which I love doing! I started it in Oct 06 and slowly expanding with lots of lovely products. I like to sell items from WAHMs that are a little bit different!
My partner Kev are getting married in Dec and I am very excited about that!!! Can't wait to see our little boy all dressed up in a suit!!

I'm a full time childminder and also am an agent with Tish Tash Toys, so kept very busy  😀
x

I'm a SAHM who has recently converted into (hopefully) a WAHM.  I have three little monkies who keep me firmly on my toes, never a dull moment in our house.  My eldest boy is 6 years old and i have twins, Jake & Samantha who are 3.
I wanted to work part time but couldn't find a single job to fit around childcare and school times so I decided to set up my own gift basket and party bag business.
www.giftmakers.co.uk
I started locally and put leaflets around local schools and after a few orders I designed my own website ( a job in  itself!!) and now sell via that.  Am loving the independence it gives me.

I'm Tanya and a WAHM and a GOTWM(go out to work mum) too LOL
I run
www.kidzfashionzone.co.uk
which sells children's clothes & accessories
good luck with your site PFC  😀

I am Anne, stay at home mum to Three children 16, 9 and 4 hmm and 44. I am also a wahm and run hmmm it won't let me tell you cause it thinks i am a spammer 😀 so i will post a few more posts and come back in two days and tell you all. 🙃
Hmm suppose i could tell you that i sell natural products including vinegar and bicarb for cleaning,craft stuff, baby stuff hmmm and about 180 other fantastic ( soon to be 200 ) products. I am also building a non commercial info site with forum ( that keeps on getting spammed   ) and have a new business in the pipe line but that's top secret.
Anne

Hi
I'm Stephanie.  I'm a SAHM to g2.5 & b6mth and I love it.
In Sept '06 I set up a business suppling sensorial materials and resources to nuseries, childminders, parents etc... Hard work but lots of fun :o)
I've been approached by customers and friends who'd like to work with me/sell my products so i'm considering expanding to become a 'party plan' or MLM business.
All comments & suggestions welcome - could this work??
Stephanie

im a scrubber by name and trade pmsl
im a full time mum and work part time as a cleaner

Hi my names annemarie
And I am an Area Manager for The Body Shop At Home
Been doing it a year and I love it. Changed my life
Hi PFC !!   I make soap and bathbombs. I have 4 children. I cnt work due to medical probs, so this keeps me active.
just a sahm here! 🙁
Hayley  You should do what I do 😀

I'm Karen and I work part time as well as being an Organiser for Usborne Books.
I'm a granny as well as being a mummy (well they are grown up now) and I need all the hints and tips on babies that you can give me as things sure have changed since mine were little!

i work 28 hours a week at a large insurance company. i'm an advisor & provide assistance to people who answer customer phone calls.  i'm taking redundancy in 3 months to be a SAHM & hopefully do cleaning jobs locally.
